sections.heading: Ranking categories
sections.body: Choose a leaderboard category to compare the measurement described by that board. Each category can rank a different participant type or progression value, so its subtitle and column labels define what is being compared.

sections.heading: Placement
sections.body: The podium highlights the current top entries, while the standings list provides the remaining ranked results. Your position is based on the latest leaderboard snapshot and can move as qualifying game data changes.

sections.heading: Pages and refresh
sections.body: Use the pagination controls to browse beyond the first results. Empty and error states do not erase recorded progress; retry or revisit the board after its data becomes available.
